$comment: The FLAT variant of shared/coder-report.schema.json that codex's --output-schema accepts (epoch 3 E3 s5 t2; RESULTS_codex_coder.md section 2): the API takes no combinator keywords, so every member of the report is required and a member the status does not use is written as null (V19). coai's own reader (core/Coder/CoderReport.cs) stays the check of a report: only a null of a member the status does not use is read as absent. The tests of ACodexCoderLaunchTests hold this file's members equal to the reader's keys.
title: coai coder report (flat)
